subject.title: Feature: TTS delivery mode option — separate text + voice messages on Telegram

question: Should OpenClaw add a public Telegram TTS delivery policy for separate text-plus-voice delivery, and should that contract live under global `messages.tts` or Telegram/channel-specific config?
rationale: The source-level need is real, but the next step creates a public config/API contract and overlaps active captioned-final and voice-only TTS directions.

options.title: Approve a narrow delivery policy
options.body: Define a backward-compatible delivery mode with docs and tests for bundled/captioned versus separate behavior before implementation.

options.title: Standardize on captioned delivery
options.body: Keep captioned voice as the supported Telegram default and document tagged/manual splitting plus overflow fallback instead of adding a new mode.

options.title: Defer until captioned-final settles
options.body: Wait for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/83988 to land or close before choosing the permanent delivery contract.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow delivery policy
recommendation.body: Define a backward-compatible delivery mode with docs and tests for bundled/captioned versus separate behavior before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans TTS config/API and Telegram delivery behavior, and this owner has the clearest TTS core provenance among the inspected history.
